cleanup.merge_incorporation_method: Pull requests #10, #11, and #12 were squash-merged, which creates a new commit and breaks commit ancestry with the reviewed feature head. Commit ancestry into main is therefore false for all three refs by construction. Incorporation was instead proved by tree identity, which is the stronger check: a branch head whose tree SHA equals the tree SHA of a commit on main contributes no content that main lacks.
